text:
erin_prod: Noticed some mismatches in the help panel vs docs during onboarding demo. Opening a short thread to sync.

nico_design: Examples?

erin_prod: The panel shows 'Highlights' but docs still use 'Callouts' in several places. Also deep links sometimes land at the page top because anchors changed.

sam_docs: I scanned the site - found 5 pages using 'Callouts'. We should pick a single canonical term.

nico_design: I'd prefer 'Highlights' for consistency with the dashboard.

ali_eng: For anchors, our static site generator sometimes renames headings when we add punctuation. We can emit stable slugs in frontmatter (canonical_slug) to avoid churn.

sam_docs: Short-term patch: console can rewrite known legacy hashes with a small map, e.g. {"callouts":"highlights","quick-actions":"routes"}. I'll add redirects.json in the docs build.

a11y-bot: a11y: reminder to ensure modal focus is managed when opening docs from the panel and to verify color contrast on snippet text.

nico_design: Agreed. Update the panel to show a 1-line excerpt + "Open full docs" (new tab) so we avoid focus traps. If we must open a modal, set aria-modal and focus the main heading.

erin_prod: Owners?

sam_docs: I'll own canonical term list + redirects.json.

ali_eng: I'll add client rewrite + analytics event (docs_deeplink_redirect) when a legacy hash is remapped. Also implement focus behavior for the modal.

nico_design: I'll update the snippet UI and check contrast.

erin_prod: Timeline: PRs by Thursday, canary Friday. Please @me. Thanks!
